notes: Large-unit check: מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה → 'on either side' — 'either' spans both demonstratives and the waw, and 'side' names nothing the Hebrew writes; no source–target allocation between the five morphemes is defensible, so the noncompositional unit stands with the first token as display anchor (rule 6). The 'which' before 'were fastened' is added: the plural participle predicates of the whole preceding clause rather than modifying the singular כֶּבֶשׁ (rule 41's predication reading).
